gitCommit.subject: authz: repos import-private to src/app — DAL/controller seam only (pv9 PR10, 25ca) (#244)
gitCommit.body:
authz: repos import-private to src/app — DAL/controller seam only (pv9 PR10, 25ca) (#244)

* feat(api): add fromDb factories to controllers (purses-25ca)

Every controller in src/server/api/ gets a static fromDb(db) factory so
routes can instantiate without importing repository implementations. New
helpers: PhotoController (with deleteWithAudit tx), AuditController,
ItemSoftDeleteService (softDeleteWithAudit tx), InvitationAcceptService
(accept tx). Existing constructors kept for unit-test DI.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH

* feat(services): tx-bound item/photo delete-with-audit services (purses-25ca)

ItemSoftDeleteService.softDeleteWithAudit + PhotoController.deleteWithAudit
wrap the withTransaction blocks that were inline in two route DELETEs.
Also adds InvitationAcceptService (accept tx), SortResultService.fromDb,
ItemPurgeService.fromDb, ItemService.fromDb for route-layer decoupling.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH

* feat(lint): forbid repo imports from src/app/api (purses-25ca)

Adds no-restricted-imports override for src/app/api/**/*.ts (excluding
*.test.ts) that blocks @/server/repositories/implementations/* imports.
npm run lint passes with 0 errors — proves no route reaches raw repos.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH

* fix(api): sessions guards use null-getter, no DB-error-as-404 (purses-25ca)

The PR10 migration replaced sessionRepo.findById (null→404, DB error→500)
with try { getSession() } catch { 404 }, which collapsed a real DB/infra
failure into a 404 — masking outages. Add SessionController.getSessionOrNull
(returns Session|null, mirrors ItemController.getItem) and use it in both
sessions/[id] (authorizeSession) and sessions/[id]/decisions: absence → 404,
a thrown DB error propagates → 500. authorizeSession now returns the resolved
session so GET reuses it instead of a post-guard double-fetch.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH

* refactor(app): pages use controllers/DAL — repos import-private to all of src/app (purses-25ca)

16 Server Component pages migrated off direct @/server/repositories/
implementations/* to the matching controllers via XController.fromDb(db).
Additive read methods added to controllers (behavior-identical passthroughs):
PhotoController.findByItem/findCoverPhotosByItemIds/findCoverPhotosByCollectionIds,
ItemController.getByCollectionAndNumber, SessionController.listByCollectionAndCurator/
getByCollectionAndNumber, ResultController.getResultOrNull/getByCollectionAndNumber,
ShareController.findByToken, MemberController.getByUser, plus a new
DecisionController.listBySession. Page guards (requireCollectionAccess) unchanged.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH

* feat(lint): extend repo-import boundary to src/app/** (purses-25ca)

Widens the no-restricted-imports override from src/app/api/**/*.ts to
src/app/**/*.{ts,tsx} (excluding *.test.{ts,tsx}) so Server Component
pages, not just API routes, are blocked from importing repository
implementations. npm run lint passes with 0 errors — repos are now
genuinely import-private to ALL of src/app.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH

* test(sessions): pin DB-error→500 (not 404) regression + drop dead throwing getSession (purses-25ca)

FIX A: add a regression test to sessions-routes.integration.test.ts that
spies SessionRepository.prototype.findById → reject and calls real GET
/api/sessions/[id] as the curator, asserting the throw PROPAGATES (NOT a
resolved 404). Verified non-vacuous: re-introducing the catch→404 masking
bug makes it fail (promise resolved Response{status:404} instead of
rejecting). Pairs with the existing null→404 case to prove 404 means
ABSENT, never FAILED. Mirrors the collection-purge atomicity prototype-spy.

FIX B: remove the now-unreferenced throwing SessionController.getSession
(every caller migrated to getSessionOrNull; grep + tsc confirm zero callers).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH

* docs: repo import-boundary (pv9 PR10) — ARCHITECTURE decision 19 + API note; epic complete

Refs: purses-25ca, purses-pv9

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH

* chore(graphify): refresh after pv9 PR10 (--force)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01Eqwo7NfuXs3szfbuZhuBdH

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
